clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven prospectors cut into the western hills of Mulgore at Bael'dun Digsite. Their search for ancient Titan relics has brought them into conflict with the tauren, who see the digging as an insult to the Earth Mother.

Dwarven prospectors dig into the mountain slopes of western Mulgore. Their camp marks the southernmost reach of the Explorers' League expedition based at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. The dwarves came with picks, shovels, and blasting powder, seeking ancient Titan relics buried beneath the plains. They paid no heed to borders or to the spiritual traditions of the newly settled tribes.

The Bloodhoof tribe sees the digging as an assault on the Earth Mother. Baine Bloodhoof first urged caution and warned the dwarves to leave, but they refused to abandon their trenches. With diplomacy failed, the tauren resolved to break the expedition's tools and drive out the miners before their digging cuts deeper into Mulgore's sacred earth.
